main_text.p: פָּתָאִים fatui, Prov. 9.6. pro פְּתָיִים, No. pl. m. à f. m. פָּתִי ; Rad. פָּתָה seductus est.
פִּתְאֹם, vel פְּתָאוֹם subitò, Part. Ad. à Rad. inusit. פָּתָא, vel à R. פָּתָה.
פְּתָהּ fatua, No. f. f. à f. m. פְּתָהּ fatuus, R. פָּתָה seductus est.
פָּתוֹת frangendo, Infin. Kal, Rad. פָּתַת.
וּבְפְּתוֹתִי & infrustulis, pl. m. constr. praef. No. pl. m. פְּתוֹתִים, Rad. פָּתַת fregit.
פְּתִי allice, Imper. Piel, f. f. Rad. פָּתָה.
פְּתִי, vel פְּתִי fatuus, fatuitas, No. f. m. R. פָּתָה seductus est.
פְּתִיּוּת simplicitas, No. sing. faem. Rad. פָּתָה.
פָּתִיל, פְּתִיל filum, פְּתִילִם, pro פְּתִילִים fila, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. פָּתַל.
פְּתִים simplices, Prov. 1. 22. pro פְּתַיִּים, No. pl. m. à f. m. פְּתִי simplicitas, Rad. פָּתָה seductus est.
וְהֲפְּתִיתְ & nunquid pelleturus esses? praet. Piel, 2. sing. m. praef. Rad. פָּתָה ; vel est pro וְהַפְּתוֹתְ & confringas, praet. Hiph, 2. f. m. Rad. פָּתַת.
פִּתִּיתִי allexi, פִּתִּיתֵנִי allexisti me, praet. Piel, 1. sing. & 2. f. aff. Rad. פָּתָה.
פַּתְלֻתַּל contortissimum, No. f. m. Rad. פָּתַל lutari.
פִּתְרוֹנוֹ interpretatio ejus, פִּתְרוֹנִים interpretationes, No. sing. m. פִּתְרוֹן, aff. & pl. m. R. פָּתַר interpretatus est.
פִּתְחָהָן pudendum earum, וְהַפְּתוֹת & cardines, No. f. m. aff. & pl. [?]

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are copied as far as they could be read at this scan size; the pointing of several entries is uncertain and may differ in detail from the printed points. The last entry's plural ending is cut at the line end. The catchword "tem." is read as printed, probably for "item.", and is marked as uncertain by its position. The page number "364" is printed only on the left page. The right page carries no printed number. The running head is the Hebrew letters pe and tav on both pages.
